# on_business_connected_bot()

**Qualified name:** `pyrogram.Client.on_business_connected_bot`

## Signature

```python
def on_business_connected_bot(filters = None, group: int = None) -> Callable: ...
```

## Documentation

Decorator for handling business bots connected to the account of the current user.

This does the same thing as [`add_handler`](../methods/utilities/add_handler.md) using the
[`BusinessConnectedBotHandler`](../handlers/BusinessConnectedBotHandler.md).

### Parameters

- **`filters`** (`filters`, *optional*)
  Pass one or more filters to allow only a subset of updates to be passed in your function.

- **`group`** (`int`, *optional*)
  The group identifier, defaults to 0.
